Debate.prompt: Whiteboard board_id=${vars.board_id}. Read whiteboard_state using alias architecture, implementation, or risk. Do not use brofile names or register. Annotate then vote. Use `challenge` only for objections that must be resolved before advancement; use `corroborate` for non-blocking reservations. Focus on AC coverage, measured context fit, deps, and integration risk. Do not edit files.

ResolveDebate.prompt: Whiteboard board_id=${vars.board_id}. Read whiteboard_summarize and whiteboard_state as alias architecture, implementation, or risk. The gate requires unresolved_challenges=0. Resolve every visible challenge against your own post with a concrete accept/reject/conditional position and `resolves=<challenge id>`; do not leave non-blocking challenges unresolved. If you authored a now-nonblocking challenge, resolve it if permitted or ask the owner to. If none are visible, add at most one useful corroboration. Update votes to match. Do not register, use brofile names, or edit files. terminal_verdicts must stay the full allowed recompose taxonomy: satisfied, work_remains, untenable.
